approach: Remove the full-suite demand at both sources. In producer.md, replace the "run the full cargo test --locked and report it" bullet with: run targeted tests (`cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`) while working; Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate. In run.rs, delete `ran_full_tests`, `enforce_tests`, `tests_missing`, the "no real full ..." problem text and the sent-back test paragraph. Keep `FULL_TEST_COMMAND` only if still used; otherwise delete it and reword the producer-report-gaps note so it no longer says to run the full suite (it says to judge the items from recorded results and run only a missing or failed check, which matches the verifier prompt). The unmet-criteria send-back stays. The post-producer checks and verdict code is not touched. Update the tests to the new behavior, then update D95's successor decision, the design doc and the CHANGELOG.

decisions.choice: Remove the gate entirely (all producers, including studies) rather than only relaxing it.
decisions.reason: The root cause is the demand in two places, prompt and enforcement. Athena's own post-producer check already runs the full suite, and a failing check still fails the verdict.

rejected.option: Reword only the prompt and keep the send-back in run.rs
rejected.why: The producer would still be sent back for lacking a full-suite result, so the cost stays.

rejected.option: Keep the gate but allow targeted tests
rejected.why: It would still gate on a report claim, which is weaker than the post-producer check that Athena runs itself.

decisions.choice: Record a new decision D113 (next after D112) amending D95 and the D103 wording, and leave D95 and D103 text as history. D95 may get a one-line 'amended by D113' note.
decisions.reason: Decisions are an append-only log. The repo convention is a new entry, and the brief asks for an amendment.

rejected.why: It would erase the history of why the gate existed.

decisions.choice: Keep `checks_run` in the producer schema, and keep fake.rs and outputs.rs behavior unless tests need a change.
decisions.reason: The producer may still report a full run. The fake producer's pass entry is harmless. fake.rs and outputs.rs are listed deliverables, so touch them only where the new prose or tests require it, for example a fake report comment or a schema description that mentions the full suite.

rejected.why: This is out of scope and breaks the report schema.

decisions.choice: Reword the producer-report-gaps note to tell the verifier to cite recorded results and rerun only a missing or failed check.
decisions.reason: It matches verifier.md (no change needed there) and removes the full-suite instruction. The note stays passed:true and a non-check.

rejected.why: Unmet-criteria gaps must still reach the verifier (D103).

files.purpose: Replace the full-suite bullet with targeted tests and a statement that Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate. Keep the budget in range.

Remove `ran_full_tests`, `enforce_tests`, `tests_missing`, the problem text and the sent-back test text. Remove or reuse `FULL_TEST_COMMAND`. Reword the producer-report-gaps note. Update the comment near line 1340.
Rework the full-test tests (about lines 1376-1505) for no send-back. Keep the unmet-criterion and failing-check tests. Rename `full_test_report` if it is now misleading.
The send-back test (line ~116) uses an unmet-criterion report instead of a missing full-test check.
Add D113 amending D95 and the D103 wording. Add a pointer from D95. The figures: nvbb six runs, 1800 s, 9 to 11 minutes.
Remove the must-run-full-suite statements near lines 772 and 1780 and describe the new rule.
Add an [Unreleased] entry with the reason and figures.
Only if needed: adjust the fake producer report note (line ~232) so it no longer implies a required full-suite entry. Otherwise no change.
Only if a schema or doc comment on `checks_run` mentions the required full-suite run, reword it. The schema keeps checks_run.

steps: Edit producer.md, then run `cargo test --locked -p athena-context` for the budgets test and any prompt content tests.

In run.rs delete `ran_full_tests`, `tests_missing`, `enforce_tests`, the test problem text and the test paragraph of the sent-back text. Simplify the break condition to `unmet.is_empty()`. Update the comments near lines 1163 and 1340. Reword the producer-report-gaps note and drop `FULL_TEST_COMMAND` if unused.

Update the tests in lifecycle.rs and job_plan.rs: a not-run or no-full-test report gives one producer call, the verifier, no send-back and no 'sent back' line. A no-change run with not-run fails with 'made no change' and without a test reason. An unmet-criterion report is still sent back once. A failing check is still rejected. The gap flag test checks that `producer-report-gaps` is shown for unmet criteria and does not say to run the full suite.
Check fake.rs and outputs.rs for wording that implies the requirement. Edit only if there is some.
Write D113 in decisions.md, with a note on D95 and D103. Update athena-v0.md lines ~772 and ~1780. Add the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry. Each states the reason with the figures from nvbb and e7bd.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle`, then the checks Athena runs.

risks.risk: A docs, TOML or data-only candidate could reach verification with the suite never run by the producer, and policy tests read non-Rust files.
risks.mitigation: The change keeps the post-producer checks and verdict code untouched. The existing failing-check lifecycle test is kept and is a criterion 4 demonstration.

risks.risk: This reverses D95, whose reason was that docs-only candidates skipped the suite.
risks.mitigation: Athena runs the full suite on the candidate and a failure rejects it, so the gate is mechanical and no longer depends on the producer's claim.

risks.risk: A dead-code warning from `FULL_TEST_COMMAND` or a test helper.
risks.mitigation: Remove all uses together. Run clippy with -D warnings and fix any leftover. Check that the gaps note still builds.

risks.risk: The producer prompt budget (1,300 tokens) is exceeded or a prompt test pins the old wording.
risks.mitigation: Check the budget test in athena-context and keep the new bullet shorter than the old one.

demonstrations.method: Read the producer.md diff with `git diff`; the athena-context prompt budget tests also run.
demonstrations.observes: The bullet no longer says to run the full `cargo test --locked`, to report it, or that not-run is unacceptable. It names `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>` and says Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate. The prompt budget tests pass.

demonstrations.method: Read the run.rs diff with `git diff`. A compile with `-D warnings` (criterion 5) proves nothing is left unused.
demonstrations.observes: `ran_full_tests`, `enforce_tests`, `tests_missing` and the sent-back test paragraph are gone. The `unmet` send-back branch and `PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS` remain.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff to confirm that `checks.rs` and the verdict code are untouched. The lifecycle test `a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier_and_every_criterion_is_judged` still passes. The gaps note text is checked in the updated gap test, and verifier.md is untouched, so its recorded-results instruction remains.
demonstrations.observes: A failing check still gives a Rejected state and a Fail verdict. The gaps note contains no instruction to run the full suite.

demonstrations.method: Rewrite the full-test tests in lifecycle.rs. A report with no full-test check and a report with `not-run` give 1 producer call, the verifier is reached and there is no 'sent back' line. A report with an unmet criterion is still sent back once, and the existing `a_criterion_*` tests are kept. A rejected candidate with a failing check stays (the existing README removal test). The no-change test with a not-run report fails with 'made no change' and without a test-related reason. Remove the 'no real full' assertion. Update job_plan.rs `a_send_back_keeps_the_plan_section...` to use an unmet-criterion report for its send-back instead of a missing test check.
demonstrations.observes: All lifecycle and job_plan tests pass: no send-back for missing tests, one send-back for unmet criteria, and a failing check is rejected.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the gate remained, the updated tests that assert exactly one producer invocation for a report with no full-test check or with `not-run` would see two, and would fail. If the unmet-criteria send-back were removed, the criterion tests would fail. If a failing check were let through, a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier... would fail.
An unused `FULL_TEST_COMMAND`, `ran_full_tests` or `enforce_tests`, or an unused test helper, would produce a dead-code warning that -D warnings turns into an error.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff. In decisions.md, add D113 after D112 and amend D95 and D103 (line ~2377: the full-test demand and the gaps note). In athena-v0.md, update line ~772 (the checks list that says the producer 'must run the full cargo test --locked (D95)') and line ~1780 (the checks_run rule). In CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased], add an entry; leave the old 0.x entry alone as history. Each states the reason: job 20261019-013309-nvbb ran the suite six times and hit its 1800 s deadline, and each run takes 9 to 11 minutes. Also run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core` for any policy test that reads the docs.
demonstrations.observes: The documents state the new rule and the figures. No current document says the producer must run the full suite.

open_questions: I did not trace the post-producer check code (checks.rs and the verdict path). I rely on the lifecycle test `a_failing_check_still_runs_the_verifier...` and the request's statement that it already runs fmt, clippy and the full suite.

Whether any policy test reads CHANGELOG.md, decisions.md or the prompt for specific words or sizes (prompt budgets, a 'Words you must not write' scan) is unknown. The producer should run the athena-context and athena-core tests after editing.
Whether fake.rs and outputs.rs need any change is undecided. They are listed as deliverables, but I saw no required edit in them.
